cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Are you all right, Metal?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: D-d-dap, wha-doo-heddle, d-d-d-doo!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal! Is something broken?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I-I-I'm all right. I think.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: My speech circuits seem a little scrambled.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What happened?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Randam pushed us into the vent and blew himself up.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, that blast must have destroyed Queen Hospital.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The solid duct absorbed the blast. Without Randam, we'd be dead.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, there's no time to grieve.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We must get back and junk Cunningham,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: or Harry and Mika will be in danger, too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We have to keep our promise to Randam.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: First, we need a way out of here!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: But I can't see anything. What now?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What's this?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It's a Tube Liner tunnel!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So Queen Hospital was connected to the Tube Liner.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. The Snatchers used these tunnels to move around underground.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They can't stand ultraviolet light.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They must have used these tunnels to stay out of the sun.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Why didn't we realize it? Subway lines run all over the city.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Now that they're abandoned, they can move around unseen.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Of course!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That figure at the factory

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: where Gibson died vanished into these tunnels!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes. The Tube Liner also runs under that factory.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That explains the sand from the factory that fell into the air vent.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I see. So that's how they did it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: They moved around without being seen

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: and stayed out of the sunlight!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: No wonder it took so long to find the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's follow the Tube Liner tracks!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We might find a way out at the nearest station.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Look! Light!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: But it doesn't look like a station.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A ladder!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Where does it lead, Gillian?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I don't know. Well, let's climb up and see.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Right. Let's climb the ladder.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's them!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Snatchers!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Get them!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Huh?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: What a strange place to end up. Oh! This is...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Freddy Nielsen's bathroom!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Freddy used this bathtub to reach the tunnels.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That explains what happened before!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: After we junked Lisa,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Freddy entered the room without using the front door?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: He was coming and going through here.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The bathtub has a double bottom. The bottom is actually a lid.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Water conceals it from view.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: To enter or leave, he'd drain all the water into a separate tank.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's how much Snatchers hate ultraviolet light.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's why they use the abandoned Tube Liner tunnels.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Come on, Gillian. Let's get outside.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Did we get him?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He's completely junked. A stubborn one, wasn't he?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: He survived that explosion? And got here ahead of us!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: If they take over the city, there'll be nothing we can do.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We have to stop them first.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Then we must keep the chief away from the summit.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I know! We owe Randam!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's borrow this taxi and hurry to headquarters.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's the plan. Mika, old man, please be safe.
